in_marathi.name: Jyotsnavi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Knowledge and Learning
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jyotsnavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jyotsna means 'knowledge' or 'light' in Sanskrit. The suffix vi denotes the feminine gender, making Jyotsnavi the Goddess of Knowledge and Learning. In Hindu mythology, Jyotsnavi is considered the goddess of wisdom and knowledge.
